object.name: deleteBusinessAccountGift
object.description: Deletes a regular gift owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for it. Requires the can_convert_gifts_to_stars business bot right. The gift can be deleted only if it isn't limited (the field total_count of the Gift is omitted) and wasn't refunded. Returns True on success.
object.html_description: Deletes a regular gift owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for it. Requires the can_convert_gifts_to_stars business bot right. The gift can be deleted only if it isn't limited (the field total_count of the Gift is omitted) and wasn't refunded. Returns True on success.
object.rst_description: Deletes a regular gift owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for it. Requires the *can_convert_gifts_to_stars* business bot right. The gift can be deleted only if it isn't limited (the field *total_count* of the :class:`aiogram.types.gift.Gift` is omitted) and wasn't refunded. Returns :code:`True` on success.
